description: The full brief for one campaign: what to create or do (action message, brief sections, content types), how submissions are judged (eligibility + selection criteria), rewards, deadline, and how many submissions the user has left. Free, read-only. If the brief links external instructions (e.g. a skill file), fetch and follow them. Then: create the content or take the action WITH the user, and call submit_campaign_work with the proof.
name: get_campaign_brief
title: Read a campaign's participation brief
